name: axiom-agency
description: Axiom digital agency — Next.js frontend + Express/MongoDB backend

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently@9 -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: npx --yes concurrently@9 -n api,web "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
